name: @w6w-apps/mindee
description: Extract structured data from documents with Mindee's OCR/AI models: enqueue extraction, classification, crop, OCR and split inferences, poll jobs, and read results.

w6w.longDescription:
Mindee turns documents into structured data. This app covers Mindee's V2 Platform API (`api-v2.mindee.net`): the five inference products a custom Mindee model can run — Extraction (a data schema you define), Classification, Crop, OCR (raw text + word positions) and Split (breaking a multi-document file into ranges) — plus the polling and search surfaces every one of them shares.

Every inference is asynchronous: an enqueue action returns a Job immediately, and a workflow either polls Job Status until it reports `Processed`/`Failed`, or relies on a webhook configured on the model itself (Mindee's V2 API has no webhook-management endpoint; webhooks are created on the Mindee Platform per model and referenced here only by ID). Once processed, the matching *-result-get action reads the structured output using the same ID the enqueue action returned.

Extraction also supports Retrieval-Augmented Generation: upload a reference document, annotate it, and Mindee uses it as context for later extractions against the same model. Model Search lists the models an API key's organization owns, which is where a workflow gets the model ID every enqueue action needs.

Health checks track Mindee's own status page, scoped specifically to the API V2 component this app calls, rather than the page's page-level roll-up.
